causal_test: training-frozen linear projection z-test with propagated holdout covariance
modal_test: training-frozen matched-filter z-test over holdout modal blocks
nodal_test: intersection-union max of preregistered one-sided flank p-values
nuisance_test: intersection-union max of calibrated holdout predictive p-values from every required nuisance family
order_test: one-sided exact sign test on eight preregistered holdout pairs per carrier
